[Update] Known Issue and Hotfix Notice
Oct 7
Hello, Commanders!
This is War of Genesis: Idle Loot.

A hotfix patch has been applied to fix an in-game issue.

[Issue Details]
An issue where equipment that previously had the equipment level requirement reduction stat displayed a different stat after maintenance

This issue has been fixed, and the original stat will be displayed correctly after reconnecting to the game.

If you applied an equipment level requirement reduction effect after the completion of today’s maintenance and before October 07, 2026, at 09:40 (UTC), some stats may have changed.

Gems of Luck that were incorrectly applied will be reissued. Please equip them again after receiving them.

Thank you.

[Notice] Official Launch Announcement
Oct 7
Hello, Commanders!
This is War of Genesis: Idle Loot.

Following about a month of Early Access that began on September 10, we are finally celebrating our official launch alongside the October 7 update.

Thanks to your enthusiastic support, we reached a peak of 52,800 concurrent players during the Early Access period, and we were able to receive a wide variety of valuable feedback for the game's improvement. We would like to express our deepest gratitude to all the Commanders who joined us on this journey.

Even though Early Access has concluded, our commitment to listening to your voices will never stop. Based on the diverse feedback and gameplay experiences you share with us, our entire development team will continue to do our very best to make the game even more enjoyable and polished.

We ask for your continued love and support as we embark on this new official launch journey, and we will always strive to provide you with an exciting and engaging gaming experience.

Thank you.

[Update] October 7 Update Announcement
Oct 6
Hello, Commanders!
This is War of Genesis: Idle Loot.

This update will introduce new skin content, profile images, frames, G-Coins, raid rewards, and artifacts, along with fixes for several issues.
Please see below for the update details and maintenance schedule.

■ Maintenance Schedule
- October 7 (Wed), 14:00 ~ 17:00 (KST)
- October 7 (Wed), 05:00 ~ 08:00 (UTC)
※ The KST and UTC schedules show the same maintenance period in their respective time zones.

■ Improvements and Additions

1. New Skin Content
- New Skins
└ Three Tier 4 skins, two Tier 5 skins, and one Tier 6 skin will be added for each class: Knight, Ranger, and Wizard.
└ Skins can be obtained from Fancy Skin Boxes sold in the Shop or through Roulette on the Skin page.
└ You can access the Skin page by selecting the Skin button above your user level in the main character window.
└ The new Tier 6 skins will be available for a limited time during 2026.
└ Skin content unlocks at user level 20.
- New Skin Product
└ Fancy Skin Boxes, which contain skins, will be added to the Shop.
└ Using a Fancy Skin Box grants a Tier 4–6 skin according to the specified probabilities.
└ When you obtain a Tier 6 skin, you will receive one you do not already own. If you own all Tier 6 skins, you will receive one of the Tier 6 skins.
- Skin Synthesis
└ A Skin Synthesis system will be added, allowing you to use duplicate skins for synthesis.
└ When you obtain a Tier 6 skin through synthesis, you will receive one you do not already own. If you own all Tier 6 skins, you will receive one of the Tier 6 skins.
└ If you own all Tier 6 skins, you cannot perform synthesis using Tier 6 skins as materials.
└ Synthesis grants Fragments of Mastery, which can be used to purchase frames.
- Exclusive Tier 6 Cutscenes
└ Equipping a Tier 6 skin will trigger an exclusive cutscene at regular intervals.
└ Each time the exclusive cutscene plays, you can obtain either a Crystal of Mastery or a Fragment of Mastery, both of which can be used to purchase frames.
└ You can obtain a combined total of up to 5 units of frame purchase currency per day through these cutscenes, regardless of currency type.
- Roulette
└ A Roulette feature will be added, offering Fancy Skin Boxes and Skin Box Exchange Stones.
└ Roulette uses a currency that replenishes at regular intervals.
└ Skin Box Exchange Stones can be exchanged for Fancy Skin Boxes in the Roulette Shop.

2. New Profile Images
- Profile images will be added.
└ Your profile image will reflect your current character and equipped skin.

3. New Frames
- Frames will be added to decorate your profile icon.
└ Frames can be purchased from Skin > Frame > Frame Shop.

4. New In-Game Currency: G-Coin
- G-Coins will be added as a currency for purchasing paid products.
- G-Coins can be purchased on the Shop page.

5. Additional Raid Rewards
- New Machina rewards will be added to the raid alliance and alliance member rewards.
- The new rewards will be granted to all members of alliances that did not finish in 1st place.

6. New Artifacts
- Equipment artifacts will be added.
└ One artifact will be added for each tier from Tier 3 to Tier 6.

7. Combat Power Ranking Display Range
- The Combat Power Ranking will be changed to display only the top 15,000 players.

■ Fixes
- An issue where the Ranger’s Lv. 65 Special Bullets was incorrectly translated as increasing range instead of poison damage in languages other than Korean will be fixed.
- An issue where the Ranger’s Lv. 45 Precision Aim was incorrectly translated as increasing poison accuracy instead of poison power in languages other than Korean will be fixed.
- An issue where the Wizard’s Lv. 55 Mana Circulation displayed text related to HP recovery instead of increased fire power in languages other than Korean and English will be fixed.
- An issue where the Wizard’s Lv. 45 Ignite displayed only accuracy instead of fire accuracy in languages other than Korean and English will be fixed.
- An issue where the Store All function stored items starting from Storage 1 instead of the selected storage will be fixed.
- Lv. 105 equipment will be made available for synthesis.

※ Maintenance details may change during development and testing.

We will continue listening to your valuable feedback and making improvements so that all Commanders can enjoy the game in a more stable and comfortable environment.

Thank you for your interest and feedback. We will keep doing our best to provide a better service.

Thank you.
[WoG] War of Genesis: Idle Loot
